method: Deterministic repeated rich-item growth, lexical postings prototype vs current in-browser literal scan. Candidate output bounded to 12. CPU timings are single-run engineering samples, not production latency. Rights resolved separately; index is never authority.
limitations: In-memory postings prototype only; no live index deployed.
English token + Japanese paired-character tokenization needs overlap and recall work before production.
These repetitions test cost and compatibility, not improved semantic relevance or a faithful two-year event history.
Shifting relevance, real revisions, independent capture and saved arrangements need additional scenarios.
